description:
## Goal

Reduce the dominant transport product population only where authoritative demand proves a position has no physical or callable obligation. Preserve position identity whenever ownership or exact dependencies differ, even when two products happen to return equal ShapeId or CallableId values.

## Current signal at a3a9761d1

One debug-interp request for `00420_enum_take_drop_split` settles:

- 4,094 TransportShape products, all distinct keys;
- 3,901 CallableConstruction products over 3,899 distinct keys;
- 9,809 products total.

These two kinds are 7,995 settlements, or 81.5 percent. The backend contains 204 executable entries and only 46 final construction wrappers. That gap is an investigation lead, not proof that the other construction products are redundant: an owner may still carry direct callable facts, layout, boundary evidence, or exact dependencies while publishing no wrapper.

The previous direction to re-key products by equal result is rejected. Equal outputs do not imply equal ownership, invalidation, or dependency identity and would violate the incremental product model.

## Preconditions

- Persistent root sessions expose cold versus retained product work.
- RuntimeDemand is reactive, so the position inventory is not distorted by whole-cone replay.
- Root relation churn is either removed or causally justified.

## Signal to add

Classify each positioned product result without formatting identity away:

- physical lanes present versus Nothing;
- callable facts present versus absent;
- construction wrapper present versus metadata-only owner versus empty owner;
- boundary obligations and direct/first-class eligibility;
- exact upstream demand fact that caused the position to be requested;
- final backend consumer that reads the answer.

Report requested keys, producer evaluations, retained cache hits, output classes, and final consumers for cold, unchanged, irrelevant-edit, and reached-edit requests.

## Output contract

- Every demanded position has an authoritative upstream obligation and a downstream consumer, or it is removed at the earliest source that can prove it unnecessary.
- Position-keyed facts remain separate when they have different owners or dependency sets.
- A provably absent physical and callable obligation does not request TransportShape or CallableConstruction downstream.
- Final packaging never scans semantic or session state to recover omitted positions.
- Persistent sessions retain unaffected positioned products across changes.
- Equal reproduction preserves generations and wakes nobody.

## Strategy

1. Measure result classes and consumer reachability after prerequisite changes.
2. Trace high-population empty or metadata-only classes back to the exact RuntimeDemand or materialization rule that requests them.
3. Strengthen that authoritative rule so impossible obligations are absent by construction.
4. Delete downstream product requests and branches made unreachable by the stronger model.
5. If every product is justified, close with the injective owner-to-consumer proof and retain the work-count ratchet.

Do not re-key by ShapeId, CallableId, rendered type, or result equality; do not add a memo around redundant requests; do not infer absence from the final wrapper count alone.

## TDD and acceptance

- Focused fixtures cover construction-present, metadata-only, direct-only, physically Nothing, and fully absent positions.
- Removed requests have zero producer evaluations and no downstream consumer.
- Retained positions name distinct ownership or dependency evidence.
- Settlement counts drop by the exactly proven removed population, or the ticket closes with a complete proportionality justification.
- Preserve interp/run/build behavior, diagnostics and demanded semantic/calling contracts. User-approved removal of proven-unused artifact parts may change pre/post canonical backend/native bytes. Every such difference must be exhaustively attributed to a proven-unused obligation; no normalization or compatibility reconstruction hides it.
- Repeated same-version unchanged requests retain byte-identical artifacts and allocations/generations; unrelated edits perform no requested-root work; relevant edits touch only exact dependents. Cross-process artifact and causal reproducibility remain mandatory.
- Metric changes are acceptable when evidence proves reduced time or work. Attribute deterministic count changes to removed work; do not raise work ceilings or weaken correctness tests to accommodate regressions.

## Checks and documentation

Run transport/product unit tests, target causal reports, persistent edit cases, full library, single-threaded matrix, all three execution doors, and clippy with warnings denied. Update transport, pipeline, fact-engine, performance instrumentation, and northstar; remove temporary census fields once permanent causal output covers the invariant.

## Prepared first TDD hypothesis after exact relation cutover

Fresh .57 verified take/drop trace (historical capture; the original temporary directory is no longer present, so current comparisons use the independently regenerated baseline below) has5329 TransportShape and5050 CallableConstruction settlements across sessions,10379/11340 total. Construction positions include602 executable inputs. Public product values are opaque, so these counts do NOT establish empty or removable populations.

First candidate: jobs/artifact.rs required_executable_input_transport_positions retains shape-Ignore inputs when callable_carrier_values syntactically finds them in call arguments, including scalar arguments ignored by the callee. semantic.rs RuntimeDemand::is_ignore() already checks both physical shape and callable demand, distinguishing a truly absent input from a direct-only callable with ShapeDemand::Ignore. ABI currently requests callable construction for every retained position.

First focused fixture: fn discard(_), do: 0; fn forward(x), do: discard(x); fn main(), do: forward(42). Prove forward input0 has settled fully ignored demand and no callable-flow obligation; measure exact positioned requests, then require zero producer evaluations if authoritative demand proves omission safe. Candidate collapse is the callable_carrier_values/input_indexes_for_values scanner into that existing demand authority. This remains a hypothesis, not authorization to remove metadata blindly: compiler2_unused_capture_layout_reaches_backend_wrapper proves physically absent carriers can still require lexical capture metadata and a wrapper. Audit semantic-input metadata and preserve runtime semantics and exact ownership; canonical differences are allowed only for proven-unused parts under the acceptance criteria.

## Current TDD evidence and model

The focused ignored-forwarded-input RED proved full settled RuntimeDemand::is_ignore and no callable flow, yet one exact TransportShape(input) and one CallableConstruction(input) evaluation occurred. Removing the syntactic carrier/input-index scanners alone removed the construction request but left shape work through an ignored CallArg recipe alias. Returning bottom from a fully ignored shape demand before following recipe aliases makes this regression GREEN.

The lexical-capture guardrail then exposed real metadata coupling: an ignored captured parameter had incidentally supplied value_layouts through the dead input. Required local Value positions now include exact RuntimeDemand.callable_flows captures as well as producer values. This preserves wrapper lexical capture metadata at its real value owner, not through an unused ExecutableInput; the existing guardrail is GREEN. Do not replace this with a backend fallback or scan.

A typed ABI-owner census after the scanner change classifies take/drop retained owners as38construction-present physical,427metadata-only (125absent/302physical), and4496empty (233absent/4263physical). These classify immutable owner.construction/callable_facts/boundary_facts and exact ABI product dependencies; they are not yet the final removed population. Scalar RED identifies two empty generic owners (main Value and return) with no callable obligation.

Candidate generic-owner omission must follow actual producer selection: retain all local CallableValue+callable_flow producers, including direct-only and physically absent metadata cases. For generic positions retain the exact positioned shape read, and omit construction requests only where the existing generic production cannot emit callable evidence (no structural Callable node). Reuse the existing structural predicate and producer selector rather than parallel scanners. Audit traversal-only dependencies before treating empty output as unnecessary work. Nothing-shaped endpoints/lexical captures can remain necessary zero-lane shape contracts; fully ignored ExecutableInput is a distinct absence proof.

Independent audit maps construction/metadata/direct-only/Nothing/fully-absent classes to existing preserving tests. RuntimeDemand::is_ignore checks both axes; TransportCarrier::Absent is not ShapeDescr::Nothing; nested callable tuple demand and lexical capture ordering remain authoritative. ReturnPayload type/demand divergence is separately tracked fz-tfn.42 and must not be silently folded into this ticket. Generic omission can avoid that discrepant helper.

Delivered in commit 54f0162e3deeaee3766e91dc40e02f6e2e2b4f3b, closed and pushed to draft PR #118. Source cold review approved subject to completion of final gates and added transition-test review. Full serial fixture matrix (531), CLI (30, including cross-process causal/artifact comparisons), runtime (210), AOT (1), and workspace documentation tests passed. Full library completed with 1846 passes, six pre-existing ignores and one obsolete exact native-work count assertion; the justified corrected assertion passes independently. Both strengthened transitions pass in the final four-test retained module. Unrelated untracked historical measurement/recovery files in .agent/measurements are preserved and excluded from this ticket.

## Broader omission RED/GREEN

The independent audit confirmed non-Callable structural trees make generic owner projection empty by exhaustive branches; traversed source evidence is discarded. Root reachability/packaging consumes ABI-owned answers, not arbitrary memo entries, and reached ABIs independently retain local callable-flow producers. Preserve the exact shape edge and local producer path; recursive scheduling remains a verification obligation.

The implemented candidate shares the local CallableValue+RuntimeDemand.flow selector between producer and ABI; generic owners are requested only when the exact structural shape contains a Callable node. Existing native shape_contains_callable moved to the transport interner/World rather than duplicating recursion. The obsolete seven-list ABI-owner iterator is removed in favor of already ordered exact position_layouts, retaining ownership filtering and shape dependencies.

Focused census is GREEN: take/drop4496emptyowners->0 while38construction and427metadata owners remain; scalar2emptyowners->0. This census alone is not delivery proof; completed retained scenarios, permanent settlement-value reporting, docs, broader gates and cold review are recorded below. No new per-owner event/counter or runtime classification store is justified.

## Verified artifact differences and approved acceptance

The committed .57 baseline (164eb394093e7848e777f0b1a40064f687a2e4af) was rebuilt in detached worktree /tmp/fz-kdt58-baseline.xEr1n9 with its own isolated target directory. Fresh baseline dumps are /tmp/fz-kdt58-before.DPvKq6 and frozen candidate dumps /tmp/fz-kdt58-observations.xhsouR. Exact cmp fails for all three canonical BackendProgram dumps; byte parity is disproven, not merely pending. No normalization or compatibility metadata was added.

Independent read-only exhaustive diff audit: range removes 3 ignored semantic-input rows and 3 associated Nothing value layouts; predicate removes 14+14, changes 27 value lanes and 4 delivered resumes to Nothing; take/drop removes 8+8, changes 20 value lanes and 11 delivered resumes to Nothing plus 2 already-zero-physical-lane EntryCapture structural layouts. All 47 changed value positions have absent (fully ignored) value demand; the two captures have explicit ignore demand. No other canonical fields changed. This is evidence for demand-justified pruning, not a waiver of artifact fidelity.

Both baseline and candidate native run commands for predicate and take/drop exit zero with identical 24-line and 38-line outputs respectively. CLIF differs: 4 predicate and 11 take/drop resume signatures lose one ignored i64 parameter. Therefore this is not solely dump formatting; internal native artifacts change too. Full regression and final cold review are recorded in the completed verification section below.

Focused frozen-tree checks pass: 88 transport tests, 3 retained relation/edit tests, serializer regression, strict all-target clippy and diff check. The verified change is committed and closed. On 2026-09-05 the user explicitly approved removing proven-unused parts and metric differences that reduce time or work. This supersedes pre/post byte identity only for those proven reductions, not semantic fidelity, deterministic reuse, or regression gates. Preserve behavior, demanded contracts, deterministic same-version artifacts, and exact incremental reuse; do not silently narrow the ticket or retain dead scaffolding merely to reproduce old dumps.


## Verified work reduction and reproducibility

Independent .57-to-.58 traces (all sessions): range CallableConstruction evaluations 882 -> 156 and settlements 834 -> 116, TransportShape evaluations 1214 -> 1201 and settlements 879 -> 873, ABI evaluations 175 -> 142. Predicate callable evaluations 2191 -> 481 and settlements 1993 -> 315, shape evaluations 2824 -> 2780 and settlements 2070 -> 2051, ABI evaluations 514 -> 424. Take/drop callable evaluations 5292 -> 716 and settlements 5050 -> 516, shape evaluations 7056 -> 7015 and settlements 5329 -> 5309, ABI evaluations 767 -> 659. Other evaluated/settled product families are unchanged. Final ABI-owner census and all-session settlements are distinct measures, not interchangeable counts.

Operator CLI work pin drops 378 -> 241 settlements, distinct generations and changed answers. Exactly 137 CallableConstruction answers disappear (160 -> 23); all 165 shape answers and other families are unchanged, cache hits remain 15 and displacements remain zero. Operator backend bytes and output remain identical to .57. The exact assertion was lowered from measured causal evidence, not by increasing a ceiling.

Fresh independent candidate observations /tmp/fz-kdt58-repeat.W98i8p reproduce all three canonical BackendProgram dumps byte-for-byte. Raw JSON lines are not claimed identical: unordered reported wait inventories and cross-process Ty mint permutations differ. Existing full CLI canonical causal/artifact comparisons pass for all three targets; no production sort or artifact normalization was introduced to hide these diagnostic differences.

## Final verification and cold review

Frozen tracked diff SHA256 339e4b5a2f3880985e620886cbd77d0b11828cef73c4ecb7817e833b9825bdec. Fresh ticket-scoped cold reviewer approved source, then independently reviewed both transition additions, both work-count adjustments and final documentation. No concrete findings remain. No production changes were needed after the initial source review.

Full serial library: 1846 passed, 1 old native-work pin failed, 6 pre-existing ignored. The sole failure was exactly 79 -> 58 evaluations: 19 scalar callable evaluations and two ABI owner-only wait evaluations removed; all other families unchanged, including 27 shape and two native evaluations. Corrected pin targeted rerun passed. Final retained module (including new generic transition) 4/4 and owner census 1/1 passed; original focused transport 88/88 and serializer regression passed. Full serial matrix 531/531, full CLI 30/30, runtime 210/210, AOT 1/1, workspace doctests (one pre-existing ignore), fmt, strict all-target clippy and diff checks passed. Test-only additions/corrected pins were retested after the full-library run without repeating unaffected compiler tests.

Both demand transitions are proved at stable exact positions: ignored -> demanded -> ignored input; generic scalar -> callable metadata/boundaries -> scalar. Withdrawal performs zero unnecessary owner requests/evaluations. Independent allocation/generation retention and same-version unchanged/unrelated root reuse remain pinned. Temporary census eprintln removed. No adapter, extra state store, scanner or migration fixture survives this cutover. Unrelated untracked historical measurements remain excluded.

Exact total settlements removed: range 724 (6 shape + 718 callable), predicate 1697 (19 + 1678), take/drop 4554 (20 + 4534). Fewer ABI waiting evaluations are 33/90/108, with unchanged 62/168/239 ABI settlements.

## Delivery

Commit 54f0162e3deeaee3766e91dc40e02f6e2e2b4f3b exactly matches the reviewed diff hash; pre-commit fmt/workspace check/strict clippy pass. Pushed only after preceding .57 head CI33986077756 was green. Current CI33991294550 is running (lint and docs passed) and gates the next push. Draft PR118 updated with changes, proof, approved artifact reductions and gate results.

Temporary detached .57 baseline worktree and its isolated 1.4GB build cache were removed after clean-status verification. Before/after/repeat trace and artifact observations remain at the recorded output paths; committed source is the authority for reproducing the baseline. No other worktrees or unrelated historical files were changed.

comments.text: fz-kdt.208 (filed from the fz-kdt.179 build, 2026-09-03) is a concrete instance of this ticket`s "prune unnecessary callable-construction products": a construction wrapper keeps the executable and boundary of a member the dispatch drop removed. Native DCEs it; interp/canon keep it. Linking as related.
